# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_IMBALANCE_CONTINUATION_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A strong opening-range bias with price above VWAP and an ascending EMA ribbon signals a higher-probability continuation move. The opening range (first 30 minutes) high-low exceeding 0.2% of SPY price, combined with the 5th 5-minute bar (25-minute mark) closing above VWAP and an ascending 8-21-34 EMA ribbon (close > EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA34) and above-average volume, indicates a high-probability long continuation.

## Mechanism

Entry: If the opening range (first 30 minutes) high-low exceeds 0.2% of SPY price AND the close of the 5th 5-minute bar (25-minute mark) is above both VWAP and the ascending 8-21-34 EMA ribbon (close > EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA34) AND that bar’s volume is above its 20-period average, then go long at the next bar’s open.
Exit: Chart-stop at the opening range low, target 1.5× risk, runner trail 10% off high-water-mark using a chandelier exit.
Regime: VIX < 20, time 09:30-10:30, ribbon sloping upward (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA34).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% of headline P&L (based on risk rules: 3 contracts at $1K, scaling to 28 contracts at $25K+).
2. **Sample bias:** No sample yet; this is a novel proposal. High overfit risk without Stage-1 backtest on 16-month SPY 5m data.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (requires walk-forward held-out window after Stage-1).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (requires realistic OPRA simulation on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: whipsaw in opening range leading to false entry and stop at OR low; max drawdown: consecutive losing days in choppy markets; blow-up scenario: volatility expansion causing OR to exceed 0.2% but then reverse sharply, hitting stop and then reversing against position.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to determine if top-5 days drive P&L.
